inbox_claim.name: inbox_claim
inbox_claim.value: ("agent_inbox"."claim_token" IS NULL AND "agent_inbox"."lease_until"=0) OR ("agent_inbox"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_inbox"."lease_until">0)

inbox_ack.name: inbox_ack
inbox_ack.value: ("agent_inbox"."state" = 'acked' AND "agent_inbox"."result_message_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_inbox"."state" != 'acked' AND "agent_inbox"."result_message_id" IS NULL)

agent_memory_bound.name: agent_memory_bound
agent_memory_bound.value: "agents"."memory_location" IS NULL OR length("agents"."memory_location") BETWEEN 1 AND 1024

participant_identity.name: participant_identity
participant_identity.value: ("channel_participants"."human_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_participants"."agent_id" IS NULL AND "channel_participants"."member_key" = 'human:' || "channel_participants"."human_id") OR ("channel_participants"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_participants"."human_id" IS NULL AND "channel_participants"."member_key" = 'agent:' || "channel_participants"."agent_id")

task_owner_state.name: task_owner_state
task_owner_state.value: ("tasks"."owner_key" IS NULL AND ("tasks"."state"::jsonb ->> 'owner') IS NULL AND "tasks"."status" IN ('proposed','cancelled')) OR ("tasks"."owner_key" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."status" IN ('in-progress','review-requested','awaiting-human','rework-requested','accepted','cancelled') AND "tasks"."owner_key" = ("tasks"."state"::jsonb -> 'owner' ->> 'kind') || ':' || ("tasks"."state"::jsonb -> 'owner' ->> 'id'))
